title: Lettuce Oracle Dragon
description: A vibrant surreal fantasy scene features a glowing green dragon wearing a yellow crown of leaves, floating inside a large crackling energy sphere with pink lightning. Below, a massive head of lettuce rests on a stone pedestal carved with horse figures, while a hooded figure holding a cabbage stands on a cliff beside a coiled green and orange dog-like creature. The dark purple background swirls with red spirals, floating cabbages, and small red dragons.
prompt: A whimsical fantasy scene with a bright green dragon wearing a leafy crown floating inside a large translucent sphere crackling with pink lightning and energy. The sphere hovers above a giant head of lettuce on an ornate stone pedestal. To the right, a hooded wizard holds a cabbage on a mossy cliff next to a coiled green dog covered in orange patterns. Dark purple swirling background with floating cabbages, red spiral symbols, and tiny flying red dragons.
